name: terra-console
description: Holographic Earth console: gesture-controlled globe with grounded AI analysis (Ask the Earth) and physics-based simulation (What-If Earth).

scripts.prepare-data: python3 tools/prepare_textures.py && python3 tools/make_webp.py && node tools/prepare_data.mjs && node tools/export_geo.mjs && python3 tools/prepare_population.py && node tools/prepare_ibtracs.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node tests/build_test_src.mjs && node tests/swe.test.mjs && node tests/unit.test.mjs && node tests/openrouter.test.mjs && node tests/osm.test.mjs && node tools/test_flood.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
